items.title: Medium acidification and redox imbalance drive triacylglycerol hyperaccumulation in Chlorella sorokiniana.
items.hook: Medium acidification and redox imbalance drive triacylglycerol hyperaccumulation in Chlorella sorokiniana.

items.title: Protein-tunable microalgae fillers for the simultaneous carbon reduction and mechanical reinforcement of rigid polyurethane foam.
items.hook: Protein-tunable microalgae fillers enable simultaneous carbon reduction and mechanical reinforcement of rigid polyurethane foam.

items.title: Vortex-regulated transport enables rapid microalgae harvesting in a sponge-inspired flow system.
items.hook: Vortex-regulated transport enables rapid microalgae harvesting in a sponge-inspired flow system.

items.title: Unlocking the potential of microalga (Arthrospira platensis) as a sustainable feed supplement for sheep: impacts on rumen dynamics, productive performance, health and product quality.
items.hook: The study shows Arthrospira platensis as a sustainable feed supplement improves rumen dynamics, productivity, health, and product quality in sheep.

items.title: Phycocyanin as a structuring agent enhances gel properties of soybean protein isolate hydrogels: Insights into noncovalent interactions involving hydrogen bonding.
items.hook: Phycocyanin from Arthrospira platensis enhances gel properties of soybean protein isolate hydrogels through hydrogen bonding interactions.

items.title: Comparative analysis of chemical composition and bioactive properties of green, honey, and white Chlorella vulgaris hydrolysates.
items.hook: Comparative analysis of green, honey, and white Chlorella vulgaris hydrolysates reveals differences in chemical composition and bioactive properties among pigment variants.

items.title: The ecological impact of Ulva prolifera green tide outbreaks: microbial connectivity and metabolic divergence.
items.hook: The study examined how Ulva prolifera green tide outbreaks influence microbial connectivity and metabolic divergence in coastal ecosystems.

items.title: Phosphonate degradation through the C-P lyase pathway by a dinoflagellate-associated Mameliella alba enhances host growth under phosphate limitation.
items.hook: A dinoflagellate-associated Mameliella alba uses the C‑P lyase pathway to degrade phosphonates, boosting host growth under phosphate limitation.

items.title: Ferric iron enhances granule densification and pollutant removal in microalgal-bacterial granular sludge via iron-homeostatic microbial rewiring.
items.hook: Adding ferric iron to microalgal‑bacterial granular sludge enhances granule densification and pollutant removal through iron‑homeostatic microbial rewiring.

items.title: Transcriptome-guided overexpression of undecaprenyl-phosphate glucose phosphotransferase drives efficient lipid accumulation in Synechococcus elongatus.
items.hook: Transcriptome-guided overexpression of an undecaprenyl-phosphate glucose phosphotransferase in Synechococcus elongatus drives efficient lipid accumulation without nitrogen starvation.

items.title: Bovine serum albumin selectively inhibits Nannochloropsis growth and induces proteostasis-associated stress responses.
items.hook: Bovine serum albumin alone inhibits Nannochloropsis growth and triggers proteostasis-associated stress responses, indicating it is not physiologically inert in cultures.

items.title: Effects of marine heatwaves and marine cold spells on toxin production in Alexandrium catenella.
items.hook: Marine heatwaves and cold spells alter toxin production in Alexandrium catenella, with temperature extremes increasing the risk of harmful algal blooms.

items.title: Beyond the Well Boundary: Strain-Specific Ammonium Overflow Drives Cross-Well Nitrogen Transfer in Microalgal Cultures.
items.hook: A 48‑well microplate cross‑diffusion assay showed strain‑specific ammonium overflow drives nitrogen transfer across wells in microalgal cultures.
